Alex Martin: Hey team — putting together a compact manager-facing first-week checklist for Jordan (starts Mon). TL;DR: quick access + 1:1s + buddy pairing + first-week goals. :wave:
Priya Desai: thanks Alex. Can we add a 'meet product tour' with Casey and a short 30/60/90 expectation chat?
Alex Martin: yes. Draft agenda below:
- Day 0 (before start): laptop shipped, email created, Slack invite, VPN + MFA instructions
- Day 1: welcome + team standup, product walkthrough (Casey), 1:1 with manager (Priya)
- Day 2: infra/CI intro (Sam), setup deep-dive, dev environment pairing
- Day 3: first small ticket + doc reading
- End of week: check-in + 30-day goals
Priya Desai: also include who-to-ask list (IT/Access/Payroll/Badge) and meeting durations.
Sam Ortiz: shipped corp laptop today, tracking #TRK12345. Network account created. Will send VPN/MFA steps in a sec.
Sam Ortiz: VPN: https://vpn.redwood.com/setup — use company SSO, then enroll MFA app. If stuck run:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "jordan@redwood.com"
pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
Jordan Lee: super excited! Quick Q — do we need a dev account before first commit?
Casey Nguyen: no, we'll pair on getting repo access. I'll add Jordan to the org and queue a GitHub invite.
onboarding-bot: PROVISIONING STATUS: email:jordan@redwood.com ✅, slack invite ✅, google drive ✅, jira invite pending.
Lila Chen: benefits call scheduled Wed 11am — calendar invite sent. New hire paperwork is in the HR portal: https://hr.redwood.com/onboard
Priya Desai: 30/60/90 (high level):
- 30-day: setup, understand product, ship small bug fix
- 60-day: own a feature area, reduce onboarding friction
- 90-day: lead a rollout or measurable improvement (latency/cost/observability)
Alex Martin: minimal manager checklist (copyable):
1) Confirm laptop & slack
2) Schedule intro + product walkthrough
3) Assign buddy (Casey)
4) Create 30/60/90 expectations doc in shared drive
5) Check access to tracking tools (Jira, GH, CI)
Priya Desai: I'll run Day 1 agenda and drop a calendar with durations. Also ping me in DM if anything blocked.
Jordan Lee: thanks everyone — appreciate the clarity. See you Monday! :rocket:
